description: This file defines an interface 'IEventHubQueueCache' related to a cache component for EventHub EventData within the Orleans streaming framework. It specifies methods for adding, retrieving, and managing cached stream events.

classes.name: IEventHubQueueCache
classes.description: Interface for a stream message cache that stores EventHub EventData, supporting operations such as adding messages, retrieving cursors, fetching subsequent messages, and managing cache pressure.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a list of EventData messages to the cache with a specified dequeue time.

methods.name: GetCursor
methods.description: Retrieves a cursor object for reading events from the cache based on stream ID and sequence token.

methods.name: TryGetNextMessage
methods.description: Attempts to fetch the next message in the cache for a given cursor.

methods.name: AddCachePressureMonitor
methods.description: Adds a monitor to observe cache pressure and aid in back pressure control.

methods.name: SignalPurge
methods.description: Triggers a purge operation on the cache, usually based on time-based policies.
